loop.top3_why_not: B (mean over pool1) has a higher overall score (0.5673) and relies on averaging across models that are not consistently top, which is less suitable for a trend‑dominated series. C (weighted inverse‑error over ETS and THETA) performs better only in one window and still has a higher overall score (0.4793); the weight estimation is unstable with only three windows and the added model (THETA) offers little benefit given the weak seasonality.
